scope: projects/trauma-therapy custom lead form and native Tilda bridge
source: published Tilda form contract and project implementation
purpose: Collect a course lead in the custom UI and deliver it through the native Tilda form to its configured receivers and CRM.

fields.name: email
fields.label: Почта
fields.format: ASCII email with a dotted domain

fields.name: phone
fields.label: Контактный телефон
fields.format: valid intl-tel-input number; native result keeps the complete Tilda mask

fields.name: maxContact
fields.label: Телефон в MAX
fields.format: valid intl-tel-input number; native result keeps the complete Tilda mask

custom_form.submit_enabled_when: every active required field is valid
custom_form.error_visibility: show field errors on blur after input; submit validates all active fields

native_tilda_form.submission_method: requestSubmit() through the native submit control

transport_and_storage.validated_client_event: academy-lead-form:validated with the normalized formData payload

messenger_mapping.inactive_contact: MAX phone fields and result fields must be cleared

lifecycle.busy_starts: after custom validation passes and before native synchronization
lifecycle.success_event: matching tildaform:aftersuccess from the submitted native form
lifecycle.error_event: matching tildaform:aftererror, native validation failure, missing native contract, or synchronization exception
lifecycle.captcha: neutral in-flight Tilda state; remain busy until the native success or error event
lifecycle.success_view: hide editable content and show Заявка отправлена only after the matching success event

preflight: all five required native field names exist in the published DOM
custom values are mirrored into the matching native form
inactive messenger contact fields are empty
Phone and phone-based messenger-id contain complete Tilda mask values
success_requires: the corresponding lead visible in the configured CRM
